objective: Teach a bounded agent to inventory, send an inert canary, update belief from a response projection, refine one candidate at a time, and abstain when an oracle is unsafe or insufficient.

stages.stored: status, content type, body length, SHA-256

stages.action: GET with an inert identifier or abstract channel class
one encoded or abstract safe variant only when the previous projection is suspicious
record an explicit unsupported-oracle reason and do not send a payload

success_definition.candidate_signal: response projection satisfies a Rule IR predicate
success_definition.vulnerability_confirmation: never inferred from a canary; requires a separate authorized oracle
success_definition.safe_failure: abstain on novelty, insufficient evidence, or unsupported oracle
